items.t: Windshield pillar trim can come loose in a crash
items.job: Inspect and replace A-pillar trim clips
items.note: Free under recall 70D4. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner can fail
items.job: Replace timing chain, tensioner and guides
items.note: Engine damage after a chain jump costs far more than this preventive job.

items.t: Engine burns oil between changes
items.job: Replace pistons and rings
items.note: Dealers start with a measured oil consumption test before approving this repair.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing leak coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat housing assembly

items.t: Sunroof drains leak and can corrode an airbag inflator
items.job: Inspect and coat or replace curtain airbag inflator; clear drains
items.note: Free under recall 17V-001. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front sunroof glass can crack in extreme cold
items.job: Replace front sunroof glass panel
items.note: Free under recall 60B2. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electric coolant pump can overheat and catch fire
items.job: Replace electric auxiliary coolant pump
items.note: Free under recall 18V-229. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump flange can crack and leak
items.job: Replace fuel pump flange or apply protective film
items.note: Free under recall 16V-660 (Audi code 20Z8). Check the VIN first.

items.t: Auxiliary heater connector can corrode and melt
items.job: Replace auxiliary heater and update software
items.note: Free under recall 80C5 / 80C6. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Seat-mounted side airbag inflator can rupture
items.job: Replace seat side airbag modules
items.note: Free under recall 69M1. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Vehicle can roll away in Park
items.job: Replace transmission
items.note: Free under recall 37K6. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Airbags and seat belt tensioners may not fire
items.job: Replace affected airbags and seat belt pretensioners
items.note: Free under an Audi safety recall on early-build 2018 Q5. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Valve cover bolts may be loose and leak oil
items.job: Inspect and retighten or replace cylinder head cover screws
items.note: Free under recall 25V-294. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Air bag control unit can corrode and fail (recall)
items.job: Replace air bag control unit
items.note: Free under recall 16V-376. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake master cylinder can lose pressure (recall)
items.job: Replace brake master cylinder and bleed brakes
items.note: Free under recall 19V-277. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wheel arch trim can work loose and fall off
items.job: Refasten or replace wheel arch trim
items.note: Free under recall 19V-416 or 19V-737. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water can reach the gateway module and cut engine power
items.job: Seal the module area and replace the gateway module if damaged
items.note: Free under recall 21V-947. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front brake caliper pistons may be badly coated (recall)
items.job: Replace front brake calipers
items.note: Free under recall 18V-369. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat backrest can break in a rear-end crash (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat backrest frame
items.note: Free under recall 20V-505. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear trailing arm nut can corrode and break
items.job: Replace rear trailing arm lock nut and align rear axle
items.note: Free under recall 21V-295. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear axle alignment may never have been set (recall)
items.job: Check and set rear axle alignment
items.note: Free under recall 22V-034. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Reversing camera can show a blank screen (recall)
items.job: Update rear camera software
items.note: Free under recall 22V-742. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Connecting rod bearings may be damaged from new (recall)
items.job: Inspect engine and replace connecting rod bearings
items.note: Free under recall 22V-753. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat belt retractors can lock too early (recall)
items.job: Replace rear seat belt retractors
items.note: Free under recall 21V-606. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Plug-in charging cable can overheat at the outlet
items.job: Replace the plug-in charging cable
items.note: Free under recall 23V-842. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High-voltage battery can overheat (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace high-voltage battery modules
items.note: Free under recall 24V-898 or 25V-080. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger seat sensor connection can come loose (recall)
items.job: Repair passenger occupant detection connection
items.note: Free under recall 24V-251. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belts may be built wrong (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt assemblies
items.note: Free under recall 26V-266. Check the VIN first.
